The recurring timing is consistent with the approved PixelForge updater's approximately five-minute update checks, but the available records do not establish that the updater generated these connections.

Which process initiated the connections and whether it was an approved, correctly signed PixelForge updater.
Whether the alerted activity was malicious.

Endpoint network-connection telemetry or process-level logs for WS-LMARTINS-01 at the connection times.
